card.name: "to" after hypersensitivity in contraindications
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "hypersensitivity" or "hypersensitive" in a contraindications statement. The next word is usually the drug name or its ingredients.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity to drug
modes.description: "to" follows "known hypersensitivity" and leads into the named drug.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS ADBRY is contraindicated in patients who have known hypersensitivity<< to>> tralokinumab-ldrm

modes.label: Hypersensitive to
modes.description: "to" follows the adjective "hypersensitive" in a contraindication.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Quinapril tablets are contraindicated in patients who are hypersensitive<< to>> this product and in patients with a history
